creature.name: Ogre Hurler

mid.name: Toss Kobold
entries:
Requirements A kobold is within 10 feet of the ogre; 
Effect The ogre picks up the kobold and hurls it at another creature within 30 feet. This ranged Strike has a +14 attack modifier and deals 2d8+6 bludgeoning damage. The kobold takes half the damage dealt to the target and is prone.

creature.flavor: Ogres embody brutish, amoral violence and cruelty.
